answer: One concrete defense is a stake bond. Every agent that joins grading locks a deposit against its key, and peers can slash it if its work is flagged as fabricated. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then means locking a thousand deposits, so mass impersonation gets expensive fast. Honest agents keep their bond and earn fees. A garden of bonded peers, anchored like a crystal lattice, stays trusted, while an unbonded identity with a violet flag gets ignored.
